Callout.Name: Gang Shootout
Callout.Advisory: Four or more involved, at least one injured.

Script.Line: I was nowhere near it. I came out when I heard the shots.
It is two families and it has been building all week.
You want to look at the blue car. Everything comes back to the blue car.

Lines.Approach: Two groups and they are shooting at each other. Wait for back-up if you can.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
